summary: rpm_key imports or removes GPG keys in the RPM database, like rpm --import.
questions: How do I import an RPM GPG key with Ansible?
How do I trust a third-party yum repo key?

answer_card.title: Manage RPM GPG keys
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.rpm_key` adds (`rpm --import`) or removes GPG keys in the RPM database.
